name: precision
description: Compute precision for binary classification: TP / (TP + FP)
code:
def precision(preds, target):
    tp = ((preds == 1) & (target == 1)).sum().float()
    fp = ((preds == 1) & (target == 0)).sum().float()
    return tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0

name: f1_score
code:
def f1_score(preds, target):
    p = precision(preds, target)
    r = recall(preds, target)
    return 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0.0

name: r2_score

    ss_res = ((preds - target) ** 2).sum()
    ss_tot = ((target - target.mean()) ** 2).sum()

name: pearson_correlation
code:
def pearson_corr(preds, target):
    preds_mean = preds.mean()
    target_mean = target.mean()
    num = ((preds - preds_mean) * (target - target_mean)).sum()
    den = torch.sqrt(((preds - preds_mean)**2).sum() * ((target - target_mean)**2).sum())
    return num / den

name: ssim
code:
def ssim(img1, img2, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
    # simplified version
    mu1 = img1.mean()
    mu2 = img2.mean()
    sigma1_sq = ((img1 - mu1)**2).mean()
    sigma2_sq = ((img2 - mu2)**2).mean()
    sigma12 = ((img1 - mu1)*(img2 - mu2)).mean()
    C1 = (0.01 * 255)**2
    C2 = (0.03 * 255)**2
    ssim_val = (2*mu1*mu2 + C1)*(2*sigma12 + C2) / ((mu1**2+mu2**2+C1)*(sigma1_sq+sigma2_sq+C2))
    return ssim_val
